n: Leopold Tenkeyless Tactile Touch (Cherry MX Brown)

cs.t: Leopold Tenkeyless Tactile Touch  http://elitekeyboards.com/products.php?sub=leopold,tenkeyles...  Cherry MX Brown switches I bought this first for home and within 2 weeks got a second one for work. I like the responsive (but not crazy loud) Cherry browns. Moving my (less used) 10-key to a separate keypad on the other side of my (much used) mouse has been the single biggest improvement. It allows my keyboard to be much more centered to my body without pushing the mouse far right.
